speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms, and has it been present since birth or did it develop later in life?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your occupation, have you noticed if the rash or neurological symptoms worsen after exposure to livestock or specific farming activities? I would also like to know if you have experienced any unintentional weight loss, night sweats, or fever over the past year.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do the hypopigmented macules on your elbows lack sensation to touch or temperature, and have you noticed any muscle weakness or difficulty with fine motor tasks? REQUEST TEST: Slit-Skin Smear

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hypopigmented macules are insensate to light touch, temperature, and pinprick; slight bilateral reduction in grip strength is present. Slit-Skin Smear results are not available in current data.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of close contact with individuals diagnosed with Hansen's disease, or have you noticed any thickening of your peripheral nerves? I will also request a biopsy of one of the hypopigmented macules to look for acid-fast bacilli. REQUEST TEST: Skin Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Skin_Biopsy: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results and clinical presentation of insensate hypopigmented macules, eyebrow loss, and peripheral neuropathy are classic for Hansen's disease. DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy
